messages:
Maya Kaur: Heads up 1: nightly billing import failed for ns-batch-20251201-01. NetSuite rejected row(s) with error 'line_description too long'. We've got 2 duplicate draft invoices in Stripe from the retries. Dropping logs and suggested short-term fix.

billing-runner-bot: [alert] billing-import-nightly job 1760123456 FAILED -> NetSuiteAPIError: LINE_DESC_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (limit=200) batch=ns-batch-20251201-01

Jordan Li: Can you share the invoice payloads? Curious if this is a new field or existing field growing.

Maya Kaur: sample invoice payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "stripe_invoice_id": "in_4Abcd...",
  "customer": "cus_XyZ12...",
  "lines": [
    {
      "amount": 25000,
      "description": "Pro Plan + add-ons: advanced-analytics; seats=250; notes={\"deploy_info\":\"prod:service-42;commit=b4f9c3e;trace=Exception: something went sideways at very long stack trace...\"}",
      "quantity": 1
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {"billing_cycle":"2025-12-01"}
}
```

Sam R.: I traced this to the usage-report->invoice transform. In commit b4f9c3e we started concatenating the service deploy metadata into the line description for debugging. That routinely exceeds NetSuite's 200 char limit. Our import pipeline retries batches on failure; Stripe invoice drafts are re-created when the job re-runs -> duplicates.

Priya Menon: Proposed emergency mitigation: sanitize/truncate the line description before generating the NetSuite CSV and before creating Stripe invoice lines. Minimal patch:
```py
# guard length for NetSuite line description
MAX_NS_DESC = 200
"desc = line.get(\"description\", \"\")"
if len(desc) > MAX_NS_DESC:
    line["description"] = desc[:MAX_NS_DESC-3] + "..."
```
This prevents the API rejection and stops requeue churn. Also recommend moving verbose metadata into invoice.metadata (not human-facing description).

Maya Kaur: I'll push a hotfix to the transform in staging now and run the one-off import. After validation, we'll promote to prod in the emergency window. Also will manually dedupe the two Stripe drafts and create reversing records if any duplicate made it into NetSuite.

Ana Gomez: Open FIN-2025-513 and loop in Accounting. Need a quick estimate of dollars and whether AR or revenue recognition is impacted. Also please include what approvals you had for the hotfix.

Maya Kaur: Created FIN-2025-513. Quick impact: 2 duplicate draft invoices totaling $1,200 USD. No posted invoices in NetSuite yet (they were rejected), so revenue recognition unaffected. Cleanup steps in ticket: 1) deploy hotfix, 2) re-run NetSuite import for ns-batch-20251201-01, 3) void duplicate Stripe drafts, 4) confirm no journals required.

billing-runner-bot: [info] billing-import-nightly job 1760123600 STARTED

Maya Kaur: Staging hotfix applied at 1760123750, staging import succeeded. Pushing to prod: https://deploys.redwood/prod/12501 (deploy id 12501).

billing-runner-bot: [info] billing-import-nightly job 1760124660 STARTED

Maya Kaur: Prod import finished at 1760124678, status=SUCCESS. No further duplicates created. Manual cleanup: voided 2 duplicate Stripe drafts, confirmed NS import accepted after re-run. Accounting acknowledged FIN-2025-513 and requested postmortem.

Ana Gomez: Thanks. Next steps: eng-payments/eng-ml to produce a postmortem in FIN-2025-513 covering root cause (why deploy metadata landed in description), remediation (move metadata to metadata field + validation tests), and a test to prevent regression (CI check to truncate/validate description length). Assign owner and deadline.

Jordan Li: Will take ownership of the postmortem and follow up with a PR that adds a validation stage to the invoice transform job.
